fact: n8n (n-eight-n; nodemation) is fair-code workflow automation: visual editor plus JavaScript/Python and npm. Repo n8n-io/n8n. Self-host or n8n Cloud; Sustainable Use License with enterprise tier. Strong fit for durable automation alongside a conversational agent.

fact: n8n provides 400+ integrations (nodes) and 900+ workflow templates (n8n.io/workflows). Use this catalog as a capability map when scoping VIKI skills or delegating integrations to n8n via webhooks.

fact: n8n AI: LangChain-style agent workflows with your data/models — docs.n8n.io/advanced-ai. Run locally with npx n8n or Docker (port 5678, image docker.n8n.io/n8nio/n8n). Docs docs.n8n.io; community community.n8n.io.
